successCriteria.description: `IBalanceService.getBalance` signature returns `Promise<LeaveBalance | null>` — the interface declares that null is returned when no balance exists for the given (employeeId, leavePolicyId, fiscalYear) tuple, rather than throwing.
`BalanceService.getBalance` returns `null` when `balanceRepo.findByEmployeeAndPolicy` returns null — no error is thrown, and the caller receives `null`.

`NotificationService.markAsRead` sets `readAt` to the current timestamp when transitioning a notification to READ status — the `updateStatus` call or equivalent persistence operation includes a `readAt` value set to `new Date()`.
`NotificationService.markAsRead` throws `NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND` when `notificationRepo.findById` returns null — the error shape is `{ error: string; code: 'NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND' }`.

`NotificationService.markAsRead` is idempotent for notifications already in READ or ARCHIVED status — calling it on an already-READ or ARCHIVED notification does not call `updateStatus` and does not throw.

All four `notify*` methods (`notifyLeaveSubmitted`, `notifyLeaveApproved`, `notifyLeaveRejected`, `notifyLeaveCancelled`) throw `EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND` when `employeeRepo.findById` returns null — error shape `{ error: string; code: 'EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND' }`.
`notifyLeaveSubmitted` and `notifyLeaveCancelled` throw `NO_MANAGER_ASSIGNED` when the employee's `managerId` is null — error shape `{ error: string; code: 'NO_MANAGER_ASSIGNED' }`.

constraints: All database access must go through repository interfaces (GP-001). The `getBalance` null-return and `markAsRead` readAt-timestamp changes must not bypass the repository layer.
Error responses must use the standard shape `{ error: string; code: string }` as defined in the reconciled architecture's error_response_contract. No new error shapes or formats may be introduced.

The `getBalance` signature change from `Promise<LeaveBalance>` to `Promise<LeaveBalance | null>` is a breaking change to the `IBalanceService` interface. All callers of `getBalance` (including `LeaveRequestService.submit`, `approve`, `cancel`) must be updated to handle the null case — they must check for null and throw `BALANCE_NOT_FOUND` themselves, preserving existing error semantics for those call sites.
outOfScope: Creating new files — all four files listed in the intent (leave-policy.service.interface.ts, employee.service.interface.ts, leave-balance.service.test.ts, notification.service.test.ts) already exist in the codebase.
Adding barrel exports — IBalanceService/BalanceService, INotificationService/NotificationService, and IAuditService are already exported from their respective index.ts files.
The duplicate-balance guard in `initializeBalance` — it already calls `findByEmployeeAndPolicy` and throws `BALANCE_ALREADY_EXISTS` when a balance exists.
The `EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND` and `NO_MANAGER_ASSIGNED` error semantics in notify* methods — all four methods already throw these errors with the correct codes.

entityInvariants.invariant: Absence of a LeaveBalance for a given (employeeId, leavePolicyId, fiscalYear) tuple is a valid domain state — it is not an error at the service-interface level. The `IBalanceService.getBalance` contract reflects this by returning `null` rather than throwing.
When a LeaveNotification transitions to READ status, `readAt` must be set to the timestamp of the transition. A READ notification without a `readAt` timestamp is an invalid state.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns `LeaveBalance | null`. Does NOT throw. Null means no balance exists for the given tuple — callers decide whether that is an error in their context.

Throws `NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND` when the notification does not exist. Idempotent for notifications already in READ or ARCHIVED status — no state change, no error. When transitioning to READ, sets `readAt` to the current timestamp.
Throws `EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND` when employee does not exist. Throws `NO_MANAGER_ASSIGNED` when employee.managerId is null. No silent fallback — both conditions are hard errors.
Throws `EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND` when employee does not exist. Throws `NO_MANAGER_ASSIGNED` when employee.managerId is null. No silent fallback.
Throws `EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND` when employee does not exist. Does NOT check managerId (notification goes to the employee, not the manager).
Throws `EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND` when employee does not exist. Does NOT check managerId (notification goes to the employee, not the manager).

consistencyRequirements.requirement: `LeaveRequestService.submit`, `approve`, and `cancel` methods call `IBalanceService.getBalance` (or `ILeaveBalanceRepository.findByEmployeeAndPolicy` directly). After the `getBalance` signature changes to return `null`, these call sites must check for null and throw `BALANCE_NOT_FOUND` themselves — preserving the existing error semantics that callers of `submit`/`approve`/`cancel` already rely on.

The `markAsRead` implementation must call `updateStatus` with `NotificationStatus.READ` AND set `readAt` to the current timestamp. The `INotificationRepository.updateStatus` signature currently accepts `(id, status)` — the implementation must ensure `readAt` is persisted. If the repository interface needs to accept `readAt`, that change must be consistent with the existing stub and any future DB-backed implementation.

The `IBalanceService.getBalance` return type must be consistent with `ILeaveBalanceRepository.findByEmployeeAndPolicy` — both return `T | null`. The service method delegates to the repository and must not add throwing semantics that the repository does not have. The `LeaveRequestService` already calls the repository directly (not the service) and already handles null by throwing `BALANCE_NOT_FOUND` — no change needed there.

integrationPoints.why: LeaveRequestService already calls the repository directly (not IBalanceService) and already handles null by throwing BALANCE_NOT_FOUND. The IBalanceService.getBalance signature change does not affect LeaveRequestService — no caller update needed there.

markAsRead must persist readAt. The current updateStatus signature only accepts (id, status). Either updateStatus must be extended to accept readAt, or a separate mechanism must set readAt. The repository interface is the integration boundary.
